description:
Found s504 by s501t (seam probes, scratch/s501t/probes/seam2.pl case 18).  PRE-EXISTING: same answer on base a0899ba6 and on main b7ec0093; not tie-specific.

Reproducer (perl 5.40.3 prints `1+2`; PCL prints `+`):
    push my @a, 1, 2;
    package K; sub m2 { my ($s, $x, $y) = @_; "$x+$y" }
    package main;
    print K::m2('K', @a), "\n";

Emission (main b7ec0093):
    (p-defcell @a (make-array 0 :adjustable t :fill-pointer 0))
    ...
    (p-let ((@a :array (make-array 0 ...))) (p-push @a 1 2))   ; the embedded my's own let, closed at the section end
    ...
    (p-print (p-list-ctx (K::pl-m2 "K" @a)) ...)               ; reads the EMPTY defcell
A statement-level `my @a; push @a, 1, 2;` is right (defcell only).  Same with `tie my @a, 'Tie::StdArray'; @a = (1, 2);` (the s501t spelling): the tie lands on the let-bound array, the later section reads the untied empty cell.
Family: #2534 (captured embedded my promotion) / #2200; this one has NO capture -- the file lexical's let ends at the package-section boundary while the defcell the later section reads was never written.  Layer: Parser2 file-lexical promotion of an expression-embedded `my` (ir-spec §2b.3).
subject: A FILE-level expression-embedded `my` (`push my @a, 1, 2;`, `tie my @a, ...;`) is invisible after a later `package` section: the read there gets the EMPTY p-defcell, silently
